TEMPTATION ||| Lean closer, brushing my shoulder against his ||| "What if I just let everyone see us?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, breaking the contact of our hands ||| "This isn't the time for games, Julian."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, vulnerability laid bare ||| "I'm terrified of what this means for us."  
REVERSAL ||| Grip the Answer tighter, asserting my power ||| "I will decide how this unfolds, not you."  
SILENCE ||| Hold my breath, the weight of expectation heavy ||| *mm*
